Nucleoplasm.description: The portion of the cell nucleus containing chromatin and non-nucleolar components.

Nuclear speckles.description: Nuclear domains enriched in pre-mRNA splicing factors.

Nucleoli.description: Dense sub-nuclear organelle site of rRNA synthesis and ribosome biogenesis.

Nucleoli fibrillar center.description: Central sub-compartment of the nucleolus where rDNA transcription occurs.

Nucleoli rim.description: Peripheral granular component surrounding the nucleolus.

Nuclear bodies.description: Non-membrane-bound nuclear structures including PML and Cajal bodies.

Nuclear membrane.description: Double lipid bilayer enclosing the nucleus and separating it from the cytoplasm.

Nuclear pore complex.description: Macromolecular channels spanning the nuclear envelope mediating nucleocytoplasmic transport.

Mitotic chromosome.description: Condensed chromatin structures formed during cell division.

Cytosol.description: Fluid component of the cytoplasm excluding membrane-bound organelles.

Cytoplasmic bodies.description: Discrete ribonucleoprotein granules in the cytosol including P-bodies and stress granules.

Aggresome.description: Perinuclear inclusion body where misfolded proteins are sequestered.

Rods & rings.description: Filamentous polymeric metabolic enzyme structures within the cytoplasm.

Peroxisomes.description: Oxidative organelles involved in fatty acid beta-oxidation and reactive oxygen detoxification.

Lysosomes.description: Acidic membrane-bound organelles containing hydrolytic enzymes for macromolecule degradation.

Endosomes.description: Membrane-bound sorting compartments in the endocytic transport pathway.

Lipid droplets.description: Neutral lipid storage organelles bounded by a phospholipid monolayer.

Endoplasmic reticulum.description: Network of interconnected tubules involved in protein synthesis and lipid metabolism.

Golgi apparatus.description: Membrane stacks modifying, sorting, and packaging proteins for secretion.

Vesicles.description: Small enclosed membrane spheres mediating intracellular transport.

Secreted.description: Proteins actively exported into the extracellular space.

Plasma membrane.description: Phospholipid bilayer bounding the outer boundary of the cell.

Cell junctions.description: Multiprotein complexes anchoring adjacent cells or linking cells to the extracellular matrix.

Focal adhesion sites.description: Integrin-containing mechanical linkages between intracellular actin bundles and extracellular substrate.

Centrosome.description: Main microtubule-organizing center of animal cells.

Microtubules.description: Tubular polymers of alpha- and beta-tubulin forming the intracellular transport network.

Microtubule ends.description: Dynamic plus and minus growing/shrinking tips of microtubules.

Actin filaments.description: Linear microfilaments providing structural support and cell motility.

Intermediate filaments.description: Rope-like cytoskeletal fibers imparting tensile strength to the cell.

Mitotic spindle.description: Bipolar microtubule apparatus segregating chromosomes during mitosis.

Cytokinetic bridge.description: Transient intercellular constriction connecting daughter cells at the end of mitosis.

Midbody.description: Dense proteinaceous structure within the cytokinetic bridge governing abscission.

Midbody ring.description: Ring-shaped assembly flanking the midbody during cytokinesis.

Primary cilium.description: Microtubule-based sensory projection extending from the cell surface.
